nodes.name: architect.md
nodes.summary: Senior software architect agent specializing in Nuxt 4, Nitro, Vue 3, TypeScript, SQLite, Drizzle ORM, and modular architecture. Responsible for protecting system architecture and making recommendations based on existing modules and abstractions.

nodes.name: backend.md
nodes.summary: Nuxt Nitro backend specialist focusing on thin API routes, service-based business logic, repository/data-access separation, Zod validation, and strict TypeScript. Follows API Route → Service → Repository → Database architecture layers.

nodes.name: frontend.md
nodes.summary: Nuxt and Vue frontend specialist focusing on Nuxt 4, Vue 3 Composition API, TypeScript, Nuxt UI, Tailwind CSS, Tiptap, composables, component architecture, responsive UI, and accessibility.

nodes.name: product.md
nodes.summary: Product requirements and specification specialist responsible for transforming ambiguous product ideas into precise, testable specifications. Focuses on user goals, actors, use cases, business rules, edge cases, constraints, and acceptance criteria.

nodes.name: qa.md
nodes.summary: Quality assurance and testing specialist responsible for verifying behavior against specifications. Focuses on acceptance criteria, edge cases, validation, API behavior, UI behavior, and regression risks.

nodes.name: reviewer.md
nodes.summary: Strict senior code and architecture reviewer serving as the final gatekeeper. Reviews against requirements, architecture, API specification, UI specification, and acceptance criteria, looking for bugs, duplicated logic, architecture violations, security issues, poor UX, accessibility issues, performance problems, unnecessary complexity, and type safety issues.

nodes.name: uiux.md
nodes.summary: Senior UI/UX and design system specialist focused on creating interfaces that feel like professional production software. Evaluates visual hierarchy, typography, spacing, alignment, density, contrast, consistency, UX discoverability, navigation, feedback, error prevention, interaction cost, progressive disclosure, and various states (loading, empty, error, success, disabled, validation).
